scope_review.notes: Scope review: tip of Crocius Syntagma Liber I Cap. 1 (definition + name-scholion + sacred/practical opening) from the 1636 Bremen Villerian Latin, not the whole folio. Era disclosed as early-seventeenth-century Reformed Bremen, not patristic.

reviews.notes: Compared Pass B to locked 1636 Villerian Latin of Liber I Cap. 1 definition + name-scholion. Practical-habit definition, Irenaeus/Hilary/Ambrose, Urbanus Regius common vs prophetic teaching gift preserved. Pass A != B. Inline John 6:45 and 1 Corinthians 14. No modern English used. Spot-check vs SLUB PHYS 121-123 OCR: negation (no one knows God unless God teaches; gift not common to all) and Scripture targets hold.

Compared Pass B to locked Latin of Cap. 1 sacred/practical opening. Sacred vs profane; practical habit vote with Ames et al.; faith through love and eternal life as end preserved. Pass A != B. Inline 1 Tim 6:20, Col 2:8, John 20:31, Rom 15:4, 2 Tim 3:16-17, Eccles 12:13, 1 Tim 1:5, 1 Cor 8/13, James 1:22-25, Rev 22:14, Gal 5:6. Spot-check vs SLUB PHYS 124-128 OCR: agency (theology intends faith) and doctrine hold.
